newsitem.title: USA: Reptron files to offer $100 mln notes.
newsitem.headline: Reptron files to offer $100 mln notes.

text.p: Reptron Electronics Inc said Friday it had filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a public offering of $100 million of convertible subordinated notes due August 1, 2004.
The notes are convertible into shares of the company's common stock at any time before maturity, unless the company redeems or repurchases them.
Raymond James & Associates Inc will be the lead managing underwriter for the offering with Forum Capital Markets L.P. serving as co-manager.
Reptron said it will grant the underwriters an option to buy up to $15 million added principal amount of notes to cover any over-allotments,
Reptron is an integrated electronics company that provides value-added distribution of electronic components and targeted contract manufacturing services through its two divisions.

The company's distribution division sells semiconductors, passive products, and electromechanical components. Its contract manufacturing division focuses on complex circuit board assembly with low to medium volume production requirements.
